title: MSL/RAD Dose-Rate Reanalysis: Code and Data (msl_2026)
description:
Reproducible analysis pipeline for a 13.5-year (SOL 00001-04843) reanalysis of Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Curiosity rover RAD dose-rate data, supporting the manuscript "Hysteresis in the Solar-Cycle Modulation of Martian Surface Radiation: 13.5 Years of MSL/RAD Observations Across a Full Cycle Reversal" (submitted to Journal of Geophysical Research: Planets).

Includes: PDS3/PDS4 byte-offset extraction libraries for RAD and REMS data, SPE-robust classical decomposition, continuous wavelet transform, Newey-West (HAC) corrected regression against sunspot number and the Oulu neutron monitor, lag/hysteresis analysis, Lomb-Scargle periodogram, mission dose-equivalent estimation, and the derived summary datasets (CSV) produced by these scripts.
